doc: A worker's job_start that is still on its way (exec/start answers 30 s late here, later than the review comes, as on the macOS lane, so the mock agent stops waiting for it after its 10 s and completes the task) when the review asks to merge is a run the gates will have: red first waits for it instead of holding on "no run to repeat", and once it is in, the gate repeats it at the test commit as it would have (here the command writes out.log in the gate's tree, so its note names the file; docs/develop/orchestration.md, "Red first").

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/repo && cd $ROOT/repo && git init -q && mkdir test && touch test/.keep && git add test && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q -m init

text:
# Plan

**Repo:** $ROOT/repo

### Task 1: Add the check

**Role:** implement

Add test/check.txt, then check.txt.

$contains.note: its tree moved while it ran (out.log): no facts kept; a file a run writes belongs in .gitignore
